Note: Ragas faithfulness scores abstentions arbitrarily, depending on their wording: a bare "I don't know." contains no claims and scores 0, while "The context does not provide X" is treated as a supported claim and scores 1 (abstentions: 11x 0, 8x 1, n=22). Faithfulness is therefore only meaningful on the 'responded' subset.
